claims.proves: the existing skill entrypoint exits with the expected status
claims.does_not_prove: semantic correctness, live service behavior, or full skill readiness

cases.name: depends-on-renders-machine-readable-blocker
command: ../run.sh maintenance 'depends-on eval' --target skills/ticket --invariant 'dependency marker is rendered' --cleanup 'preview only' --scoped-files skills/ticket --proof 'cd /home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills && skills/agentic-evals/run.sh run skills/ticket/fixtures/agentic_eval.json --case depends-on-renders-machine-readable-blocker --output /tmp/ticket_depends_on_eval.json shows READY' --route backend_python_or_skill_runtime --depends-on grahama1970/pdf_oxide#31 > /tmp/ticket_depends_on_preview.out && grep -q 'blocked-by: grahama1970/pdf_oxide#31' /tmp/ticket_depends_on_preview.out && grep -q 'depends_on: grahama1970/pdf_oxide#31' /tmp/ticket_depends_on_preview.out

cases.name: routable-requires-agentic-eval
command: repo=$(git -C .. rev-parse --show-toplevel) && cd "$repo/skills/ticket" && uv run --project . python scripts/eval_routable_requires_agentic_eval.py

cases.name: close-audit-parses-markdown-scoped-files
cases.notes: Regression guard for Markdown issue bodies such as '- **Scoped files:** ...'. The close wrapper must scope the worktree audit from the machine-readable scoped-files line instead of falling back to every dirty secondary worktree.

cases.name: github-actions-is-opt-in-not-default-proof
command: repo=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && skill="$repo/skills/ticket/SKILL.md" && grep -q 'Ticket verification defaults to deterministic local proof' "$skill" && grep -q 'Do not dispatch GitHub Actions by default' "$skill" && grep -q 'not part of default ticket verification' "$skill" && grep -q 'spending-limit failure blocks' "$skill" && grep -q 'only the CI/cloud proof path' "$skill" && echo GITHUB_ACTIONS_OPT_IN_ONLY
cases.notes: Regression guard for the ticket policy that local deterministic proof is the default and GitHub Actions is an explicit, narrow opt-in path.
